DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer in writing before she goes to the principal.
What moved her: Nothing, because no evidence about the essay or the process was put in front of her, so she had nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: Hale never answered who decided on the zero or whether Owen was heard first, and spent the meeting asking what she was instead, which left her question standing.
Try next time: When she opens by asking why the mark was entered before anyone phoned her, answer that in one plain sentence about your own process before saying anything else.
